parts.label: 3.0L 2JZ-GTE Twin-Turbo I6
parts.summary: The legend — a sequential-twin-turbo inline-six so overbuilt it shrugs off 600–700 whp on the stock bottom end.
parts.detail: 2JZ-GTE — 3.0L sequential-twin-turbo inline-six, 320 hp stock (276 hp JDM). A closed-deck iron block and forged crank make it one of the most overbuilt engines ever sold.
parts.watch: Age, not engineering: aging turbos and hoses, and period R12 A/C. Verify with a compression and leakdown test.

parts.label: 17" Wheels & Tires
parts.summary: Staggered alloys on wide rubber — the footprint that puts the 2JZ's torque down.
parts.detail: Factory staggered wheels on performance tires, sized to feed the RWD Torsen limited-slip and the 2JZ's broad torque.
parts.watch: Curb rash on the low-profile fronts; owners often upsize for big-power builds.

parts.label: Four-Wheel Vented Discs
parts.summary: Large vented discs front and rear — strong for the era and easily upgraded.
parts.detail: Large vented discs at all four corners — strong stoppers for the mid-'90s and a common target for big-brake kits on tuned cars.
parts.watch: Warped rotors and aged flexible lines on 25-plus-year-old cars; upgrade for track or big-power use.

parts.label: Interior & Driver's Cockpit
parts.summary: The wraparound driver's cockpit that defined the '90s Japanese GT.
parts.detail: The A80's driver-angled dash and wraparound cockpit, with the lift-out targa panel stowing behind the seats on T-top cars.
parts.watch: Aging factory electronics and gauges; hardened targa seals cause rattles and leaks.

parts.label: Lighting & Electronics
parts.summary: Pop-up-era lighting and the A80's period electronics suite.
parts.detail: The A80's headlight and tail-lamp assemblies plus its mid-'90s electronics — simple and robust, but aging.
parts.watch: Aging factory electronics, gauges, and R12 air conditioning are the era's weak points.

parts.label: Body, Targa & Glass
parts.summary: Steel unibody with a lift-out targa top — clean examples have appreciated hard ($80k–$150k+).
parts.detail: Steel unibody with the signature lift-out targa top and big rear wing. Values for clean, unmodified cars have climbed steeply.
parts.watch: Rust at the rear hatch, wheel arches, and battery tray; hardened targa seals leak, rattle, and let in wind noise.

parts.label: V160 6-Speed & Torsen LSD (RWD)
parts.summary: The Getrag V160 six-speed sending the 2JZ's torque rearward through a Torsen limited-slip.
parts.detail: Getrag-built V160 6-speed manual (the one to have) or a 4-speed auto, driving the rear wheels through a Torsen limited-slip differential.
parts.watch: The V160 is stout but expensive to replace; clutches on hard-driven and modified cars are a common wear item.

parts.label: Double-Wishbone Suspension
parts.summary: Double-wishbone front and rear — a genuine sports-car chassis under the grand-touring bodywork.
parts.detail: Double-wishbone suspension at all four corners gives the A80 a real sports-car chassis. (Shown as a procedural stand-in — not a separate mesh in this model.)
parts.watch: Tired bushings and shocks on 25-plus-year-old cars; a full refresh restores the intended handling.
